text:
maria: DSAR came in — user requests erasure of 'demo-snap-042'. It looks like that snapshot exists in us-west1 and an old GCS backup bucket. Anyone know if it's subject to a legal hold or retention exception?
jordan: I can check ownership/exports. @amy-legal any hold on demo-tenant-42?
amy-legal: Not on our tracker yet. If we can't remove data immediately we'll need a retention-exception and to log attempted deletion evidence.
maria: Also flag — the snapshot is encrypted with a customer-managed key cust-demo-42. If we rotate or revoke the key, does that legally satisfy erasure? cc @kevin
kevin: Short answer: no. Key rotation alone isn't 'erasure' for DSAR purposes. We need to delete snapshots/objects and document the deletion. Also need an RBAC sweep for who has decrypt/cryptoKeyVersions access and snapshot export permissions.
jordan: Running checks now. Commands I'll use:```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/xx/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/cust-demo-42
gcloud compute snapshots list --filter='name~demo-snap-042' --uri
```
sec-bot: [ALERT] Created ticket SE-712 for vuln-triage — telemetry-uploader SA used snapshot export role last week.
maria: If telemetry-uploader exported this to external storage, we need chain-of-custody. Jordan, any export logs?
jordan: No exports to external sinks in last 90d. Found read of snapshot metadata on 2025-11-09 by telemetry-uploader (no object copy).
kevin: Recommend immediate RBAC change: remove snapshot export role from telemetry-uploader, rotate any long-lived creds used for exports, and add a temporary IAM condition to deny access to demo-snap-042 while we perform deletions. I'll draft commands.
amy-legal: If the requester provided legal proof, we should attempt deletion unless product tells us this snapshot is evidence for an ongoing investigation — verify with product.
maria: I'll open a retention-exception ticket with provenance logs and ask infra to schedule a deletion window. We should also add explicit snapshot.delete events to the long-term audit sink for future DSAR evidence.
jordan: Ack — I'll add a sink filter and extend TTL on audit logs. PR will be infra#4387.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a runbook: steps to revoke exports, delete snapshot, verify object removal in GCS, and KMS zeroization notes. Note KMS key destruction has a scheduled delay; object deletion must happen first.
amy-legal: Thanks, team. If deletion can't be completed within 48h we'll file an official retention exception and notify the requester with expected timeline.
maria: Assigning tasks: jordan -> audit logs + delete; kevin -> RBAC + KMS guidance; amy-legal -> hold check with product. I'll update when tasks complete.
jordan: PR link: http://git.internal/infra/PR/4387
maria: Filing DSAR ticket DSAR-9931 with current notes and timeline. Will update thread when deletion confirmed. :eyes:
